final: SELECT a.frequency, COUNT(*) AS frequency_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS count_divided_by_total, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS count_divided_by_average FROM disp AS d INNER JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency ORDER BY a.frequency
